take: Florida announced it placed center Aleksander Barkov on long-term injured reserve and called up defenseman Alexander Petrovic from Charlotte (AHL). Barkov had been playing 14:53 a night on the third line. In the 5 games since he went out, Lars Eller has taken his spot beside Reinhart and Tkachuk, rising to 16:07 a night from 13:16, and Bokondji Imama has gone to 8:32 from 5:40. Florida has controlled 56% of the quality of chances at five-on-five this season, and with Barkov on the ice that share was 75% over two games.
